# Ezekiel 6 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 6:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying: |
| LOGOS | The word of the LORD came to me: |
| PNEUMA | The LORD spoke to me again: |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 6:4 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-your-altars shall-be-desolate, and-your-incense-stands shall-be-broken; and-I-will-cast your-slain before your-idols. |
| LOGOS | Your altars shall become desolate, and your incense altars shall be broken, and I will cast down your slain before your idols. |
| PNEUMA | Your altars will be smashed, your incense altars shattered, and I will throw your dead bodies down in front of your idols. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 6:6 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | In-all your-dwelling-places the-cities shall-be-laid-waste and-the-high-places shall-be-desolate, so-that your-altars are-laid-waste and-made-desolate, and-your-idols are-broken and-brought-to-an-end, and-your-incense-stands are-cut-down, and-your-works are-wiped-out. |
| LOGOS | Wherever you dwell, the cities shall be laid waste and the high places shall be ruined, so that your altars will be laid waste and ruined, your idols broken and destroyed, your incense altars cut down, and your works wiped out. |
| PNEUMA | Wherever you live, your cities will be demolished and your hilltop shrines torn down. Your altars will be wrecked, your idols smashed, your incense altars chopped down, and everything you've made will be obliterated. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 6:8 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | But-I-will-leave-a-remnant, in-your-having some-who-escape [the]-sword among-the-nations, in-your-being-scattered among-the-lands. |
| LOGOS | Yet I will leave some of you alive. When you have among the nations some who escape the sword, |
| PNEUMA | But I will spare some of you. Some will escape the slaughter and be scattered among the nations. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 6:12 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | The-far-one by-the-pestilence shall-die, and-the-near-one by-the-sword shall-fall, and-the-one-remaining and-the-one-besieged by-the-famine shall-die; and-I-will-spend My-fury upon-them. |
| LOGOS | He who is far off shall die of pestilence, and he who is near shall fall by the sword, and he who is left and is preserved shall die of famine. Thus I will spend My fury upon them. |
| PNEUMA | Those far away will die of plague. Those nearby will fall by the sword. Those who survive the siege will starve. I will pour out all My fury on them. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 6:5 (overlap: 6%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-I-will-lay the-corpses-of the-sons-of Israel before their-idols, and-I-will-scatter your-bones around your-altars. |
| LOGOS | And I will lay the dead bodies of the people of Israel before their idols, and I will scatter your bones around your altars. |
| PNEUMA | I will pile the corpses of the Israelites in front of their idols and scatter their bones around their altars. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---
